title: Push to GitHub
question: By what chain of grants does a hosted agent change a repository — and where does the thing that stops it living on the wrong branch actually live?

story.beat: The user authorises the Claude GitHub App once; every session after that inherits the decision.
This session pushed release commits to dev — permitted by mandate v2, refused once by v1, and the refusal is the estate's best story.
The constraint that keeps this agent off main is prose in its own context — tier expectation, quoted below from the twin itself.
